fato_historico: 2006: A massacre is carried out by Sri Lankan government forces, killing 17 employees of the French INGO Action Against Hunger (known internationally as Action Contre la Faim, or ACF).
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a call to honor the fragility and resilience of human connection. Just as shadows remind us to cherish every flicker of kindness, you might find yourself reflecting on the importance of global compassion. It is a good time to channel your Aquarian vision toward acts of altruism and peaceful intentions in your community.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in the gentle power of helping those who need it most.
significado_numero: Represents the seeker of truth and the champion of humanitarian causes.
conselho: Consider reaching out to support a charitable cause that resonates with your heart today.
